title: L0177
description: Output of an L0177 program — the normalized Author API integration design plus steering warnings. This is NOT the deliverable; the developer-facing recipe is produced by get_spec. Atomic dialect (not a composition upstream).

mode.description: The Author API view the design targets.

domain.description: The serving domain the signature binds to.

allow_widgets.description: Restricted set of allowed widget types.

organisation_id.description: Which item bank to load from.

complete.description: True when the design has no unfilled required properties (holes).

warnings.description: Steering hints: design holes first (missing required properties), then specificity advisories. The client refines the design until these clear.
